title: Suppression of Postprandial Monocyte Activation by Blueberries or Docosahexaenoic Acid in Humans

sections.abstract: The overall goal of the research study is to determine whether a high-fat meal causes postprandial (after meal) inflammation, and whether eating n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) or blueberries that are rich in anti-inflammatory polyphenols suppress the inflammation in healthy people.
